approval_related_names.codex.tool_decision: log event (codex_otel.log_only), emitted when the decision is applied; not a span event
approval_related_names.codex.approval.requested: metric counter with attributes tool, approved; incremented after the decision
approval_related_names.decide_request: root span from ext/guardian-v2/src/async_scorer/approval.rs, attribute approval_id only, ends at the moment the approval is requested
spans for the decision op, attribute submission.id
approval_related_names.codex.tool_call_received / codex.tool_re: span events (codex_otel.trace_safe) with conversation.id, turn_id, call_id

service_names_observed.codex-app-server: app-server and managed daemon (TUI threads by default)
service_names_observed.codex_cli_rs: TUI process (--no-daemon: everything; daemon mode: client spans only)
service_names_observed.codex_sdk_ts: Codex SDK (codex exec under the hood)
